remarks: Completely renovated and expanded, this turn-key home combines classic charm with modern convenience. As you approach the property, you are greeted by a beautifully landscaped front yard and a welcoming exterior that exudes warmth and character. Step through the front door and into a bright, open-concept living area. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace and large windows that flood the space with natural light, highlighting the elegant hardwood floors and tasteful finishes while the adjacent dining area is ideal for entertaining guests. The well-appointed eat-in kitchen boasts high-quality appliances, clean-line cabinetry, and generous countertop space, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. The home offers five bedrooms and five full bathrooms each thoughtfully designed to provide a relaxing retreat. The primary bedroom is a true sanctuary, complete with an en-suite bathroom and a walk-in closet. Additional features include two home offices, and a large bonus room with a wet bar providing tons of optionality. Outside, the stone terrace is an entertainer's dream with outdoor dining space, a pergola with additional seating, hot tub, as well as a built-in barbeque with bartop seating. Full house generator. Located in a serene & friendly neighborhood, this home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience. With top-rated schools, local parks, and vibrant community amenities close by, this home is ideally situated for enjoying all that Darien has to offer.
